text: I text him again and again after a fight and he leaves me on read
she says she needs space but I cant stop trying to fix it right now
he came in and immediately started criticising me for everything I did today
we were both shouting and I couldn't even hear myself think
my hands were trembling and I couldn't speak, I was so furious
I hurt her badly last night, I want to say sorry the right way
he only looks at his phone when I tell him about my day
she rolls her eyes and mocks the way I speak
whatever problem I raise he somehow makes it about my mistakes
after every argument she doesn't speak to me for days
I realised I don't know what makes him anxious or what he dreams about
he never considers my opinion when we plan anything
his job is exhausting him and he's short with me every evening
he lives in another country and we only manage calls twice a week
my sasural people comment on my cooking and my husband stays silent
with his whole family in one house we never get a minute alone
we met just twice before our marriage and I feel shy around him still
we fight every month about the EMI and how much to give my parents
ever since our daughter arrived we are both exhausted and bickering
he blames my hormones whenever I tell him something hurt me before my period
she goes through my chats and gets angry if I talk to my male friends
we text every day but he refuses to tell me if we are actually together
my boyfriend of three years ended things and I can't eat
I keep wanting him to say again and again that he is not leaving me
he buys me things but never says anything sweet and I want words
he says sorry quickly but then does the same thing again
we are hosting twenty relatives for the festival and I am doing all the work while he relaxes
we love each other but our families belong to different communities and disapprove
my husband and I haven't been physically close in months and I don't know how to bring it up
I discovered he had been lying about his whereabouts for weeks
everyone's relationship on instagram looks perfect and ours looks dull
my wife has been crying a lot and seems very low, I want to help her
he is still very friendly with his ex and it bothers me
mere pati mujhse kai din baat nahi karte jab ladai hoti hai
woh mujhe sabke saamne neecha dikhata hai aur hasta hai
saas mere har kaam mein galti nikalti hai aur pati kuch nahi kehta
usne mujhe chhod diya aur main roz roti hoon
can you suggest a simple lunch I can carry to work
I have a doctor appointment on Friday and I am nervous about the results
my boyfriend gave me flowers and I am so happy today
I am trying to drink more water and sleep earlier
my brother and I argued about whose turn it was to do the dishes
my wife's birthday is next week and I need gift ideas
I cant sleep and my mind is racing about tomorrow's presentation
the old couple next door are adorable, they hold hands everywhere
I want to lose a little weight before the wedding in March
my best friend got engaged and I am planning her bachelorette
aaj office mein bahut kaam tha aur main thak gaya
mujhe kal subah jaldi uthna hai
he said he loves the dinner I made
my cousin moved abroad for work and I miss her
I tracked my steps with my watch and I walked a lot
